title: Bracket shock response
line: A response spectrum FEA study of a steel bracket under a 1000 g shock spectrum.
description: Shock response of a steel wall-hook bracket (40 x 50 x 35 mm) bolted at its three mounting holes. The mounting sees a pyrotechnic shock along the wall, given as a 5% damped shock response spectrum rising from 20 g at 100 Hz to a 1000 g plateau from 2 kHz. Modes combine by CQC.
thumbnailAlt: Peak displacement of a steel bracket under a shock response spectrum, solved in RunMat
